complete_grammar_inventory.build: PostgreSQL 18.3 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0, 64-bit
complete_grammar_inventory.scope: Native pg_catalog inventories of the observed installation; optional extension languages and arbitrary user schemas retain separate acceptance.

identifier_quoting.syntax: Native unquoted folding; exact double-quoted identifiers with doubled quote escapes.

string_literals.syntax: Native observed standard_conforming_strings and escape/unicode/dollar string forms; no global editor mode override.

parameter_binding.syntax: libpq extended-query numbered parameters; client named/positional pyformat binding is separate from native SQL text.

transaction_control.syntax: Native PostgreSQL transaction authority; retained editor transactions and independently owned administration attachments.

pagination.syntax: Native LIMIT/OFFSET and FETCH; provider cursor pages preserve native row and type identity.

explain.syntax: Native EXPLAIN; ANALYZE executes the selected statement and is separate from nonexecuting syntax checks.

cancellation.syntax: Native owned libpq cancellation key; acknowledgement is separate from native transaction finality.

coverage.qualification_scope: Provider SQL compiler tasks only. Preserved HTTP forms, physical-tool jobs, platform qualification and full-product completion retain separate acceptance.
